The '''Trupellia system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the theory known as [[Trupellian probability]].<ref name="BH">''[[The Bounty Hunters: Scoundrel's Wages]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Trupellian probability]]|system=Trupellia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Trupellia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-13.<ref name="TEA" />
